malaysia:MY-01.name: Johor

population.note: Midyear estimate for both sexes, all ages and ethnicities, including non-citizen residents. DOSM reports thousands of people, rounded to 100 people; the annual CSV date is a year label, not 1 January.

area.label: Land area
area.note: Official reported land area from JUPEM and the Sabah and Sarawak land-survey departments, published in DOSM Statistics Yearbook 2024, table 1.1.

realGdp.note: Overall GDP (sector p0) at constant 2015 prices, converted from RM millions. USD is an estimate in constant 2015 dollars using the 2015 average MYR/USD rate; it is not nominal GDP in current dollars.

realGdpPerCapita.note: Real GDP divided by DOSM’s total midyear state population for the same year. Includes citizens and non-citizens. Calculated from published rounded population, so it may differ slightly from a separately published per-capita series. USD retains the same constant 2015 price basis.

malaysia:MY-01.note: Population, area and economic output have separate reference years. These statistics cover the entire state or federal territory; districts do not inherit these totals.
